title: Level-one weight of the balanced lift
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and define its balanced lift on $\{-1,1\}^{n+1}$ by $g(z)=z_0 f((z_0z_{i+1})_{0\le i<n})$. The level-one Fourier weight of $g$ equals the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over all subsets of size at most one, with coefficients computed under the uniform measure.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
